SELECT
  SUM(payment_cents) AS payment_cents
  , SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  , SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , SUM(gross_cents) AS gross_cents
  , SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    subq_7.order__channel AS order__channel
    , order_store_src_10000.region AS store__region
    , subq_7.__payment_cents AS payment_cents
    , subq_7.__refund_cents AS refund_cents
    , subq_7.__net_sales_cents AS net_sales_cents
    , subq_7.__gross_cents AS gross_cents
    , subq_7.__discount_cents AS discount_cents
  FROM (
    SELECT
      store_id AS store
      , channel AS order__channel
      , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end AS __payment_cents
      , case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end AS __refund_cents
      , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS __net_sales_cents
      , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end AS __gross_cents
      , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end AS __discount_cents
    FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_src_10000
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_7
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "data"."main"."stores" order_store_src_10000
  ON
    subq_7.store = order_store_src_10000.store_id
) subq_11
WHERE (order__channel in ('小程序')) AND (store__region in ('华东'))
answer: 统计范围为青禾当前数据中2026年8月、小程序渠道且订单成交门店地区为华东的已支付订单行；取消单不计，退款按原订单下单日期归属，优惠金额不因退款冲减。结果：实付金额297.00元，退款金额0.00元，净销售额297.00元，支付订单原价金额322.00元，优惠金额25.00元。退款金额为零表示该统计范围内已支付订单的退款合计为零。金额已由分换算为元。
